Descriptive: Workflow & Process present in 96.2% (mean fraction 43.5%), Coding Style 87.5% (39.3%), Project Structure 87.5% (37.6%), Architecture 82.5% (29.9%), Agent Rules 56.2% (8.0%), Evolution Context 26.2% (2.3%). 73.8% contain no evolution content; 0% mention Lehman's laws; Phase 13.8%, Tech debt 12.5%, Refactoring plans 10%, Complexity trend 6.2%, Churn 5.0%. Evolution presence by type: CLAUDE.md 28.3%, Copilot 33.3%, AGENTS.md 19.0% ('statistically indistinguishable'). Only Coding Style vs law conformance rho=0.431, p=0.040 (n=23); not significant after Bonferroni

fields.v: Taxonomy boundary (Architecture vs Evolution) could shift estimates; larger human-annotated benchmark for the classifier planned; >=30 stars over-represents well-maintained projects; CLAUDE.md dominates (57.5%); RQ3 n=23 underpowered (~45% power), all correlations non-significant after Bonferroni, exploratory. Cultural explanation of the gap needs qualitative evidence. Future: corpus n=200+, longitudinal tracking of manifests, controlled experiments on downstream agent decision quality with/without evolution context; manifest linters, enrichment tooling, templates

fields.v: Printed page numbers 369-374 = PDF pages 1-6. Table II and Table III came out jumbled; Table II rebuilt from text and Fig. 1 (counts/percentages/fractions in matching order); Table III appears to be extracted column by column (one line per variable: Age, Stars, Cmts, Phase, Law, A.R.), consistent with Coding Style x Law = .43*, but only that pair (from text) was used. Inconsistencies: abstract and related work say 'five' agent/manifest types, contributions and conclusion say 'four manifest types', queries targeted six types; corpus has four types. Inclusion criterion is >=6 months since creation, but corpus age range is reported as 5-179 months. Fig. 4 caption says low-conformance projects are <=0.25, text says <=0.5. Discussion calls the rho=0.431 correlation 'significant' after stating it does not survive Bonferroni. Ref. [9] (253 CLAUDE.md files) is attributed to 'Ramaswamy et al.', arXiv:2506.01784. Inter-model and human kappas given only as thresholds ('> 0.65', '> 0.75'). How the 23 repositories' Lehman phase and law conformance were obtained ('population metadata') not explained. Replication package: https://github.com/cnacha-mfu/seo-replication/tree/jcsse2026 (corpus, classifier, scripts). No pre-registration. Languages: TypeScript, Python, C#, Rust, Go
